BR.hook: First digit = region: 1 São Paulo down to 9 the Amazon
BR.summary: The first digit tells you the region: 1 São Paulo state, 2 Rio and Espírito Santo, 3 Minas Gerais, 4 Paraná and Santa Catarina, 5 Rio Grande do Sul, 6 the Centre-West with Tocantins, Rondônia and Acre, 7 Bahia and Sergipe, 8 the rest of the North-East, 9 the far North and Maranhão.

groups.label: Pernambuco, Alagoas, Paraíba, Rio Grande do Norte, Ceará & Piauí

BR.tip: A state's capital usually ends in 1: 11 São Paulo, 21 Rio, 31 Belo Horizonte, 41 Curitiba, 51 Porto Alegre, 61 Brasília, 71 Salvador, 81 Recife, 91 Belém.

RU.hook: 3 Urals & Siberia, 4 Moscow & the Far East, 8 west & south
RU.summary: The first digit splits Russia in three: 3 the Urals and Siberia, 4 Moscow and Central Russia but also the Far East, 8 the North-West, the Volga and the South. The second digit narrows it: 49x around Moscow, 81x St Petersburg and the north, 86x–87x the Caucasus, 38x–39x Siberia, 41x–42x the Far East.

groups.label: Moscow & Central Russia, Kaliningrad & the Far East
the North-West, the Volga & the South with the Caucasus

RU.tip: 4 is the tricky one: 47x–49x sit around Moscow (495 and 499 are the city), while 41x–42x are on the Pacific side.

ID.hook: One digit per island group: Java 2–3 to Papua 9
ID.summary: After the 0 the first digit is the island group: 02 western and central Java, 03 East Java, Bali and Nusa Tenggara, 04 Sulawesi, 05 Kalimantan, 06 northern Sumatra, 07 the rest of Sumatra, 09 Maluku and Papua.

groups.label: Jakarta, Banten, West Java, Central Java & Yogyakarta
the rest of Sumatra, the Riau Islands & Bangka Belitung

ID.tip: The digits hop west to east like a ferry route: Java 2–3, Sulawesi 4, Borneo 5, Sumatra 6–7, then 9 for the far east. 08 is for mobiles, never a place.

AU.hook: Four codes, four zones: 02 NSW, 03 VIC, 07 QLD, 08 the rest
AU.summary: Australia has just four codes, one per big zone: 02 New South Wales and the ACT, 03 Victoria and Tasmania, 07 Queensland, 08 Western Australia, South Australia and the Northern Territory.

groups.label: Western Australia, South Australia & the Northern Territory

AU.tip: Numbers starting 04 are mobiles and say nothing about the place.

MX.summary: The first digit gives the zone: 55 Mexico City, 6 the north-west, 8 the north-east, 9 the south-east, 2 Puebla, Oaxaca and Veracruz, 3 the west around Guadalajara, 4 the Bajío, 7 the centre-south (Guerrero, Morelos, Hidalgo). Border states mix two digits.

groups.label: Guanajuato, Querétaro, Aguascalientes, Zacatecas, San Luis Potosí, Jalisco & Michoacán
Mexico City & the State of Mexico
Baja California, Baja California Sur, Sonora, Sinaloa, Chihuahua & Durango
Guerrero, Morelos, Hidalgo, the State of Mexico, Michoacán & Veracruz
Nuevo León, Coahuila & Tamaulipas, plus one Baja California Sur code
Yucatán, Quintana Roo, Campeche, Tabasco, Chiapas, Oaxaca & Veracruz

MX.tip: Only the three biggest cities have two-digit codes: 55 Mexico City, 33 Guadalajara, 81 Monterrey.

FR.hook: Five zones clockwise from Paris: 01 to 05
FR.summary: France has five zones and the digit after the 0 names them: 01 Paris and Île-de-France, 02 the north-west, 03 the north-east, 04 the south-east and Corsica, 05 the south-west.
FR.tip: Read it like a clock from Paris: 02 top left, 03 top right, 04 bottom right, 05 bottom left. 06 and 07 are mobiles.

ZA.summary: After the 0 the first digit gives the area: 01 the north (Johannesburg 011, Pretoria 012), 02 the Western Cape (Cape Town 021), 03 KwaZulu-Natal (Durban 031), 04 the Eastern Cape and the Garden Route (Gqeberha 041, George 044), 05 the Free State and Northern Cape (Bloemfontein 051, Kimberley 053).

groups.label: Western Cape & part of the Northern Cape
Eastern Cape & the Garden Route in the Western Cape

ZA.tip: The Western and Northern Cape each use two digits, so 02/04 and 02/05 both point west.

ES.summary: Skip the leading 9 (or 8, used for newer lines): the next digit is the area. 1 Madrid, 3 Barcelona, 5 Andalusia, 6 Valencia and Murcia, 8 Galicia, Asturias and the north-west, 4 the Basque Country and the north, 7 Aragon, the Balearics and Catalonia outside Barcelona, 2 Extremadura, the west of the Meseta and the Canaries.

groups.label: Extremadura, the Canaries, Toledo, Ciudad Real, Ávila, Salamanca & Segovia
the Basque Country, Navarre, Cantabria, La Rioja, Burgos & Guadalajara
the Valencian Community, Murcia, Albacete & Cuenca
the rest of Catalonia, Aragon, the Balearic Islands, Palencia & Soria

ES.tip: 91 Madrid and 93 Barcelona are the only two-digit codes; every other province has three digits (95x Andalusia, 96x Valencia…). Castile is split between 2, 4, 7 and 8.

IT.hook: Runs down the boot: 01 north-west to 09 Sicily
IT.summary: After the 0 the first digit runs down the boot: 01 the north-west, 02 Milan, 03 the rest of Lombardy, 04 the north-east, 05 Emilia-Romagna and Tuscany, 06 Rome, 07 central Italy and Sardinia, 08 the south (Naples, Bari), 09 Sicily and Calabria.

groups.label: most of Piedmont, Aosta Valley & Liguria
the rest of Lombardy, with Novara & Verbano-Cusio-Ossola
Campania, Abruzzo, Molise, most of Puglia & Matera
Sicily, Calabria, Potenza, Taranto & part of Salerno

IT.tip: Big cities get the short codes: 02 Milan, 06 Rome, 010 Genoa, 011 Turin, 051 Bologna, 055 Florence, 081 Naples, 091 Palermo.

TR.summary: After the 0 the first digit splits Turkey west to east: 2 the west (Istanbul 212/216, İzmir 232, Antalya 242), 3 central Anatolia, the western Black Sea and the eastern Mediterranean (Ankara 312, Adana 322), 4 the east and the eastern Black Sea (Diyarbakır 412, Erzurum 442, Trabzon 462).

groups.label: the West: Marmara, the Aegean & the western Mediterranean
Central Anatolia, the western Black Sea & the eastern Mediterranean
Eastern Anatolia & the eastern Black Sea

TR.tip: The second digit narrows it: 021x is Istanbul, 031x Ankara, 046x the Trabzon coast.

PH.summary: Drop the 0 and the first digit is the island zone: 2 Metro Manila, 4 southern and central Luzon, 7 northern Luzon, 5 Bicol and Eastern Visayas, 3 Western and Central Visayas, 6 western Mindanao and Sulu, 8 eastern and northern Mindanao.
PH.tip: Manila is the only one-digit code (02); Cebu is 032 and Davao 082.

CO.hook: 60 + one digit per zone: 601 Bogotá, 604 Medellín
CO.summary: Every landline starts with 60 and the third digit is the zone: 601 Bogotá, 602 the south-west (Cali), 604 Antioquia (Medellín), 605 the Caribbean coast, 606 the Coffee Axis, 607 the Santanders, 608 everywhere else (the east, the south and San Andrés).

groups.label: the east, the south & San Andrés

CO.tip: The third digit is the old one-digit code with 60 put in front, which is why there is no 603.

PE.summary: The first digit gives the zone: 1 Lima, 4 the north-centre (Trujillo, Áncash), 7 the north coast and Cajamarca, 6 the central highlands and the Amazon, 5 the south (Arequipa, Puno, Tacna), 8 Cusco and the south-east.

groups.label: La Libertad, Áncash, San Martín & Amazonas
Junín, Huánuco, Pasco, Ayacucho, Huancavelica, Loreto & Ucayali

PE.tip: Lima is the only one-digit code (1); Cusco is 84, Arequipa 54.

CL.summary: The first digit, north to south: 5 the desert north, 3 Valparaíso, 2 Santiago, 7 O'Higgins and Maule, 4 Ñuble, Biobío and Araucanía, 6 Los Ríos down to Magallanes.

groups.label: Los Ríos, Los Lagos, Aysén & Magallanes

CL.tip: Santiago is the only one-digit code (2); the far ends of the country are 5 (north) and 6 (south).

PL.summary: The first digit gives the area: 1 the south-east (Kraków 12), 2 Warsaw, 3 Silesia (Katowice 32), 4 Łódź and Radom, 5 the north (Gdańsk 58), 6 the west (Poznań 61), 7 Lower Silesia and Opole (Wrocław 71), 8 the east (Lublin 81, Białystok 85), 9 the north-west (Szczecin 91).
PL.tip: Polish landlines still start with these two digits even though you no longer dial them separately.

UA.hook: Moves east: 03 west, 04 Kyiv, 05 centre-east, 06 Donbas
UA.summary: After the 0 the first digit moves east: 03 the west (Lviv 032), 04 Kyiv and the centre-north plus Odesa (044, 048), 05 the centre-east and south (Dnipro 056, Kharkiv 057), 06 Zaporizhzhia and the Donbas.

groups.label: Lviv, Volyn, Rivne, Ternopil, Khmelnytskyi, Ivano-Frankivsk, Zakarpattia & Chernivtsi
Kyiv, Zhytomyr, Chernihiv, Cherkasy, Vinnytsia & Odesa
Dnipropetrovsk, Kharkiv, Poltava, Sumy, Kirovohrad, Mykolaiv & Kherson

UA.tip: Kyiv is 044; Odesa (048) is the odd one out, a 04 code down on the south coast.

US.hook: Every first digit turns up coast to coast
US.summary: US area codes were handed out with no regional order: in 1947 the busiest cities got the quickest codes to dial (212 New York, 213 Los Angeles, 312 Chicago, 313 Detroit), and every first digit turns up all over the country.
US.tip: The US is hard to learn by pattern. Learn the big-city codes one by one if you want the extra edge.

CA.hook: Same plan as the US: codes scatter across provinces
CA.summary: Canada shares the US numbering plan, and a province's codes spread over many first digits: Ontario alone has codes starting with every digit from 2 to 9.
CA.tip: The original codes are worth knowing: 416 Toronto, 514 Montreal, 604 Vancouver, 403 Alberta, 902 the Maritimes.
